messages:
Amy Chen: Quick Q — in the batch vectors preview, if user toggles 'Sort: Relevance' then hits Export CSV, the resulting file seems to keep the original upload order. Feels confusing.
Jordan Li: Seen this. Export should respect current view/sort. Otherwise users have to re-sort in Excel which is annoying.
Rajesh Patel: Agree. Also we need to decide if 'Export' should include the relevance score column by default or behind a toggle.
Kelly O'Neil: Accessibility nit: when the export modal opens, keyboard focus lands on the modal title instead of the primary action. Primary CTA should be first tabbable element.
Amy Chen: Good catch Kelly. Proposed copy for CTA: "Download CSV (respect current sort)" — long but explicit. Thoughts?
Jordan Li: Shorter: "Download CSV — current view" or "Export current view". Keep the label scannable.
Rajesh Patel: Implementation note: backend currently streams rows in stored index order. We can apply client-side sort before export if dataset size < 50k rows; otherwise call new endpoint param ?sort=view to ask server to emit in-view order. Need product decision on acceptable perf tradeoff.
Kelly O'Neil: From an a11y POV, the export endpoint should also support `role=document` responses so screen readers can announce file generation status. Also add an ARIA live region with progress.
Amy Chen: UX decision: default include columns = ["id", "text_preview", "vector_dim", "relevance_score"]. Make `relevance_score` optional toggle in the modal with tooltip: "Included when 'Sort by relevance' is active."
Jordan Li: I prefer including it by default — it's often the reason folks export. But we can hide advanced options behind "More export options".
Rajesh Patel: For CSV header propose: `id,text_preview,vector_dim,relevance_score,metadata` — sample row: `123,"welcome to redwood",768,0.87,"{""owner"": ""team-a""}"`
Kelly O'Neil: Minor copy nits: change "text_preview" -> "preview_text" for clarity. Also confirm we escape JSON strings in metadata column.
Amy Chen: I'll update the mock and add two small flows: 1) client-side sort & export for <= 50k rows, 2) server-side `?export_sort=current` for larger exports.
design-bot: Note created: design ticket #DX-4127 "Export current view: batch vectors" (assignee: Amy Chen). :white_check_mark:
Jordan Li: Can we add a tiny visual hint in the preview header like: "Export respects current sort and filters" so folks don't get surprised? Small gray helper text.
Kelly O'Neil: And keyboard shortcut reminder — show `Ctrl+D` in the modal header (or make configurable). Also ensure focus returns to export button after download completes.
Amy Chen: Great. I'll push an updated Figma with copy tweaks and the modal a11y changes by EOD and link the ticket. Thanks all!
